{{Top|notoc=1}}
'''Hyperwave transceivers''', '''Hypertransceivers''', '''hyperradio transceivers''',<ref name="TDC">''[[The DarkStryder Campaign]]''</ref> or '''hyperwave transmitters''',<ref name="Gamer">{{GamerCite|7|Secrets of Mos Eisley}}</ref> were secure methods of interstellar communication, used aboard most [[Warship/Legends|warships]] or large private starships.<ref name="RPG2RE">''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game, Second Edition, Revised and Expanded]]''</ref> These were similar to [[Subspace transceiver/Legends|subspace transceivers]], but sent their signals through [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]], rather than [[Realspace/Legends|realspace]] or [[Subspace/Legends|subspace]], giving them effectively unlimited range.<ref name="SoG">''[[Starships of the Galaxy]]''</ref> They were, however, limited to video and audio communication, and very expensive for the everyday use of regular citizens.<ref name="Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game, Second Edition, Revised and Expanded">''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game, Second Edition, Revised and Expanded]]''</ref>

Millions of hyperwave [[Relay station/Legends|relay stations]] were tethered in static positions within hyperspace across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], giving rise to the term "non-mass" [[Hyperwave/Legends|hyperwave]] transceivers, due to their lack of mass or size outside of hyperspace. These transceivers served as relay stations for messages sent across the [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]], and were responsible for sending Holonet messages across [[Simu-tunnel/Legends|S-threads]] to locations all across the galaxy.

==History==
Notable users included the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]], aboard their [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigates]], and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], aboard their [[Communications ship|communications vessels]]. One was also integrated into [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray's]] [[Mechno-chair/Legends|mechno-chair]].
